headings: Greene County Bancorp, MHC 以及 Greene County Bancorp, Inc.
Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 以及其子公司
paragraphs: Greene County Bancorp, MHC 於 1998 年 12 月成立，為 Bank of Greene County 的相互制持股公司重組之一環。2001 年，Greene County Bancorp, MHC 從州級轉為聯邦級牌照。美國聯準會規範 Greene County Bancorp, MHC。Greene County Bancorp, MHC 持有 Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 已發行且流通普通股的 54.1%。Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 剩餘股份由公開市場股東及 Bank of Greene County 的員工股票所有權計畫持有。2025 年 6 月 30 日，Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 的資產主要為其對 Bank of Greene County 的投資、現金及證券。2025 年 6 月 30 日，Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 普通股 7,808,300 股，每股面額 0.10 美元，由公開市場持有，包括高層主管及董事 195,852 股，作為庫藏股持有，以及 9,218,528 股由 Greene County Bancorp, MHC 持有，Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 的相互制持股公司。Greene County Bancorp, MHC 除了持有 Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 普通股的多數股權及投資 Greene County Bancorp, MHC 的流動資產外，不從事任何其他業務活動。

Greene County Bancorp, Inc.（本公司）為 Bank of Greene County 的聯邦級持股公司。Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 於 1998 年 12 月根據 Bank of Greene County（原為 Greene County Savings Bank）的董事會 trustee 為目的成立，作為 Bank of Greene County 的持股公司。2001 年，Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 將其牌照從 Delaware 公司（受美國聯準會董事會規範）轉為聯邦公司（受 thrift 監督辦公室規範）。根據多德-弗蘭克法案，自 2011 年 7 月起，聯邦級儲蓄貸款持股公司的規範權轉移至美國聯準會。Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 的主要業務為監督及指導 Bank of Greene County 的業務並監測其現金狀況。

Bank of Greene County（銀行）於 1889 年成立為 Catskill 的建築與貸款協會，為紐約州核准的儲蓄貸款協會。1974 年，Bank of Greene County 轉為紐約州的相互制儲蓄銀行，名為 Greene County Savings Bank。配合 1998 年 12 月完成的重組及發行，導致 Greene County Bancorp, Inc. 的成立，Greene County Savings Bank 改名為 Bank of Greene County。2006 年 11 月，Bank of Greene County 將其牌照轉為聯邦儲蓄銀行牌照。Bank of Greene County 的存款由美國聯邦存款保險公司所管理的存款保險基金承保，上限為法律所允許的最高金額。

Bank of Greene County 的主要業務為吸引零售存款，來自其分行周圍地區的公眾，並將這些存款與來自營運及借款產生的資金，主要投資於住宅抵押貸款、商業不動產抵押貸款、消費者貸款、住宅貸款及商業貸款。此外，Bank of Greene County 將其資產的相當大一部分投資於州及地方政府證券及抵押貸款支持證券。Bank of Greene County 的收入主要來自住宅及商業不動產抵押貸款的利息，其次則來自消費者及商業貸款的利息及其他類型證券的利息，以及來自存款帳戶的服務費及手續費、ATM 卡費用收入及銀行自有壽險收入。Bank of Greene County 向客戶提供投資選擇，這些選擇也透過 Osaic Institutions, Inc. 貢獻收入，使銀行能將這些替代投資服務重新品牌為 Greene Investment Services。Bank of Greene County 的主要資金來源為存款、從紐約聯邦住宅貸款銀行（FHLB）的借款，以及貸款及證券的本金與利息償還。

Bank of Greene County 運作一個有限目的子公司，Greene County Commercial Bank（商業銀行）。Greene County Commercial Bank 於 2004 年 1 月成立為紐約州核准的有限目的商業銀行。Greene County Commercial Bank 只有權接受美國及紐約州及其各自代理人、權力機構及附屬機構，以及地方政府的資金作為存款，如紐約州一般市政法第 10(a)(1) 條所定義。
格林縣銀行亦經營一個不動產投資信託，名為格林物業持有有限公司。格林物業持有有限公司於2011年6月成立為紐約州公司，並根據美國內政部稅收法規選擇以不動產投資信託方式課稅。格林縣銀行已將某些房貸及貸款的受益權轉讓給格林物業持有有限公司，以換取格林物業持有有限公司100.0%的普通股。格林縣銀行繼續根據與格林物業持有有限公司簽訂的管理及服務協議，為這些房貸客戶提供服務。

Greene County Bancorp, MHC、Greene County Bancorp, Inc.、Bank of Greene County、Greene County Commercial Bank 及 Greene Property Holdings, Ltd. 的行政辦公室均位於紐約州 Catskill 的 302 Main Street，郵遞區號 12414-1317。電話號碼為 (518) 943-2600。

Regulation G, a rule adopted by the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC"), applies to certain SEC filings, including earnings releases, made by registered companies that contain "non-GAAP financial measures." "GAAP" is generally accepted accounting principles in the United States of America. Under Regulation G, companies making public disclosures containing non-GAAP financial measures must also disclose, along with each non-GAAP financial measure, certain additional information, including a reconciliation of the non-GAAP financial measure to the closest comparable GAAP financial measure (if a comparable GAAP measure exists) and a statement of the Company's reasons for utilizing the non-GAAP financial measure as part of its financial disclosures. The SEC has exempted from the definition of "non-GAAP financial measures" certain commonly used financial measures that are not based on GAAP. When these exempted measures are included in public disclosures, supplemental information is not required. Financial institutions like the Company and its subsidiary banks are subject to an array of bank regulatory capital measures that are financial in nature but are not based on GAAP and are not easily reconcilable to the closest comparable GAAP financial measures, even in those cases where a comparable measure exists. The Company follows industry practice in disclosing its financial condition under these various regulatory capital measures, including period-end regulatory capital ratios for itself and its subsidiary banks, in its periodic reports filed with the SEC, and it does so without compliance with Regulation G, on the widely-shared assumption that the SEC regards such non-GAAP measures to be exempt from Regulation G. The Company uses in this annual report additional non-GAAP financial measures that are commonly utilized by financial institutions and have not been specifically exempted by the SEC from Regulation G. The Company provides, as supplemental information, such non-GAAP measures included in this annual report as described immediately below.

Fully Tax-Equivalent Net Interest Income and Net Interest Margin: Net interest income, as a component of the tabular presentation by financial institutions of Selected Financial Information regarding their recently completed operations, as well as disclosures based on that tabular presentation, is commonly presented on a tax-equivalent basis. That is, to the extent that some component of the institution's net interest income, which is presented on a before-tax basis, is exempt from taxation (e.g., is received by the institution as a result of its holdings of state or municipal obligations), an amount equal to the tax benefit derived from that component is added to the actual before-tax net interest income total. This adjustment is considered helpful in comparing one financial institution's net interest income to that of another institution or in analyzing any institution's net interest income trend line over time, to correct any analytical distortion that might otherwise arise from the fact that financial institutions vary widely in the proportions of their portfolios that are invested in tax-exempt securities, and that even a single institution may significantly alter over time the proportion of its own portfolio that is invested in tax-exempt obligations. Moreover, net interest income is itself a component of a second financial measure commonly used by financial institutions, net interest margin, which is the ratio of net interest income to average interest-earning assets. For purposes of this measure as well, tax-equivalent net interest income is generally used by financial institutions, again to provide a better basis of comparison from institution to institution and to better demonstrate a single institution's performance over time. While we present net interest income and net interest margin utilizing GAAP measures (no tax-equivalent adjustments) as a component of the tabular presentation within our disclosures, we do provide as supplemental information net interest income and net interest margin on a tax-equivalent basis.

The Company is a community bank offering a variety of financial services to meet the needs of the communities it serves. At June 30, 2025, the Company operated 18 full-service banking offices, lending centers, an operations center, customer call center, administration center and a wealth management center, located in its market area consisting of the Hudson Valley and Capital District Regions of New York State. The primary market area the Company serves is the Greene, Columbia, Albany, Ulster and Rensselaer Counties of New York State.

paragraphs: 本公司營運成果主要取決於其淨利息收入，此為本公司貸款及證券投資組合所賺取之收入與資金成本（包括存款及借款所支付之利息）之間的差額。營運成果亦受本公司信貸減損提列、非利息收入及非利息費用所影響。非利息收入主要為費用及服務費用。本公司非利息費用主要為薪資及員工福利、營運空間、設備及資料處理，以及其它營運費用。營運成果亦受到總體經濟及競爭條件、利率變動，以及政府政策與監管機構行動的重大影響。此外，未來適用法律、法規或政府政策的變動，可能對本公司產生重大影響。
為成功營運，本公司必須管理各種類型的風險，包括但不限於市場或利率風險、信貸風險、交易風險、流動性風險、安全風險、戰略風險、聲譽風險及合規風險。
市場風險係指因市場價格及/或利率不利變動而導致損失的風險。由於淨利息收入（貸款及投資所賺取之利息與存款及借款所支付之利息之間的差額）為本公司主要收入來源。淨利息收入受利率變動以及本公司資產與負債的水準與期限變動所影響。
利率風險係影響本公司最重要的市場風險，因本公司大部分資產與負債對利率變動皆具敏感性。本公司主要資金來源為存款及貸款、抵押貸款證券及債務證券之本金與利息償還所得。雖然貸款及證券的到期日與預期償還為可預測的資金來源，但存款流出、抵押貸款提前償還及貸款活動則大幅受到總體利率、經濟條件及競爭的影響。
信貸風險係指因客戶（已貸款予其）及債務證券發行者（本公司已投資）未能履行其義務，而對本公司獲利及股東權益所造成的風險。風險程度取決於借款人及債務發行者償還能力與意願，以及用以擔保貸款或投資之財產價值是否充足。
流動性風險係指本公司可能無法履行現有或未來財務承諾，或過度依賴替代性資金來源的風險。本公司目標為在滿足存款人現金流量需求的同時，資本結構成長。管理階層負責流動性監測，並在需求與變動時有不同來源的流動性。這些需求包括貸款成長與償還、證券購入與到期、存款流入與流出，以及借款償還。管理階層持續監測趨勢，以識別可能改善本公司流動性地位預測性與時間安排的模式。
作業風險係指對現有或預期獲利或資本造成影響的風險，因內部流程或系統不足或失敗、人員的不當行為或錯誤，以及不利的外部事件。作業損失來自內部詐欺；外部詐欺包括網路安全風險；員工作業與工作場所安全、客戶、產品及業務作法；對實體資產的損害；業務中斷與系統故障；以及執行、交付與流程管理。
